old_field_work_assessment.current_behavior: capture checks current stored snapshot using cycle-start now at whole_body_mppi.py:635; post-plan and delivery check latest self.snapshot (:741,766,777), intentionally allowing a newly arrived map to validate delivery.
old_field_work_assessment.reject_additional_lifetime_margin: A remaining-life<estimated-solve prefilter could discard cycles that receive a new valid snapshot during solve. It reduces the 10Hz delivery opportunity and causes earlier extra zero publications; not a safe no-behavior-change performance optimization.
old_field_work_assessment.reject_field_version_dedup: Same h14 ESDF does not imply same dynamic points, measured state, phase, goal or proposed action. Skipping repeated field versions is incorrect.
old_field_work_assessment.possible_tiny_correction: Use actual ROS time after capture lock acquisition rather than original cycle now to avoid checking freshness with a stale clock. This only addresses lock-delay acceptance; if large lock waits are not measured it is not worth mixing into producer latency fix. It can stop earlier, not guarantee fewer interruptions.
old_field_work_assessment.recommendation: Do not add waiting/age-reserve/field-dedup gates in current latency fix. Improve measured producer-to-delivery timing while retaining regular command opportunities and current latest-state checks.
